newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: TENNIS-FILIPPINI WINS FIFTH CAREER TITLE.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-FILIPPINI WINS FIFTH CAREER TITLE.

text.p: Uruguay's unseeded Marcelo Filippini won the fifth clay court tournament of his career on Saturday with a 7-6 6-2 win over Australian Patrick Rafter in the St.Poelten Grand Prix.
Filippini, ranked 73 in the world, needed a little over an hour and a half to send the $425,000 tournament's only remaining seed, Rafter, crashing out.
"It was a tough and very tight match," said a pleased Filippini, who also won in Atlanta earlier in the year.

"The secret was that I was able to keep Rafter at the back and didn't allow him to play serve and volley," Filippini said about his seventh seeded opponent who eliminated top seed Thomas Muster in the quarter-finals.

The 29-year-old Filippini made the St.Poelten finals with a first round victory over Spain's Juan Albert Viloca, before profiting from fifth seeded Marc Rosset's retirement due to a strain in his upper thigh.
He then defeated Sweden's Tomas Nydahl in the quarter-finals and Slovak Dominik Hrbaty in the semifinals.
